text:
Priya: Quick thread — finalizing run-of-show for the Apr 5 webinar. Working title: 'Practical inference: micro-demos + cost-saving patterns'. Proposed format: 20m keynote + 3x5m live micro-demos + 15m AMA. Need quick signoff on abstracts, speaker assignments, rehearsal slots, and fallbacks.

Sasha: +1 on the format. For the abstract copy we should lead with a concrete metric (e.g., 3x cost reduction) and a short list of takeaways for engineers. I can draft a 2-line abstract.

Kevin: I'm good to do the keynote. Can cover routing, batching, and when to pick quantized weights vs fallbacks. Will do 20m.

Miguel: For demos I can do model fallback and routing policy demo. Suggest the three demos be: 1) KV-prefix caching (warm cache speedups), 2) smart routing + fallback to cheaper model, 3) quantization + batching tradeoffs.

Tara: I can demo quantization+batching. I have a short script that shows delta in p50 latency and token cost — only need 5m.

Priya: Perfect. Sasha, can you take Demo 1 (caching)? Kevin keynote + Miguel demo 2 + Tara demo 3.

Sasha: Yep. Will prepare a tiny harness: single prompt -> repeated requests (cold vs warm) and a small table screenshot. Keeping it <5 slides.

Miguel: For the fallback demo, plan is: start with primary large model, throttle it in the harness, then show automated routing to a compatible quantized variant + captured metrics. If live fails, we have a 90s recorded video at https://drive.redwood/demo-fallback-90s.mp4.

Priya: Important: all demos must have a pre-recorded clip and a static fallback screenshot in case the infra hiccups. Ops-bot — flag slot for tech rehearsal?

ops-bot: Tech rehearsal slot reserved: Apr 3 10:00-11:00 PDT. Dry-run (full run-of-show) Apr 4 09:00-10:00 PDT. Links posted in #calendar.

Kevin: Run-of-show snippet — please copy/edit as needed:

```
00:00 — Welcome & agenda (Priya) 3m
03:00 — Keynote: practical inference patterns (Kevin) 20m
23:00 — Demo 1: KV cache warmup (Sasha) 5m
28:00 — Demo 2: routing + graceful fallback (Miguel) 5m
33:00 — Demo 3: quantization + batching (Tara) 5m
38:00 — Panel Q&A (all) 15m
53:00 — Close & CTAs (Priya) 2m
```

Priya: Rehearsals: please arrive 10m early. Tech rehearsal will focus on demo plumbing (keys, model variants, network throttling). Dry-run will be slide timing + handoffs.

Sasha: Action items for me: draft 2-line abstract + 1-slide demo deck + sample prompts. ETA: Mar 29 EOD.

Kevin: I'll send the keynote deck (10 slides) and a short list of benchmarks to show during talk. ETA: Mar 30.

Miguel: I'll prepare the routing script and a short golden metrics screenshot (p50/p95 + cost delta). Also will produce the 90s backup video. ETA: Mar 30.

Tara: I'll attach the quantization notebook + a pre-sampled chart showing cost/latency tradeoff. ETA: Mar 30.

Priya: Content checklist: abstract, 1-slide demo, pre-recorded 90s fallback clip, static result screenshot, 2 sample prompts per demo, slide deck link. Please drop artifacts into this shared folder: https://drive.redwood/webinar-practical-inference/ by Mar 31.

Kevin: Quick note on prompts for demo 2 (routing): use prompts that produce variable sequence lengths to trigger routing logic. Example prompts:
- "Summarize the following long policy document in 3 bullets..."
- "Write a short email reply to this long customer thread about billing..."

Sasha: For caching demo prompts: repeating a user query is fine. Example: "Explain KV caching for real-time chat and show perf." We'll include a cold->warm timeline.

Miguel: Contingency plan (short): if live demo errors -> 1) switch to recorded clip, 2) show static screenshots + read the script, 3) offer to follow up with raw logs if audience asks. Keep a 2-line explanation for hosts to read if we skip live.

Priya: Marketing asks: 1) Short abstract for landing page (one-sentence + 3 bullets). 2) 1-line speaker bios. 3) CTA: signup link + demo repo link. Sasha/Kevin — can you supply bios?

Sasha: Yes. Will drop a 1-line bio now.

Kevin: Dropping bio in channel and will add to slide footer.

Priya: Last thing: who is handling live chat during the webinar for lead routing? Recommend: Marketing ops + Solutions SE to triage. Suggest @Miguel handle solution follow-ups and @Tara help triage tech questions in chat.

Miguel: I'm in. Will monitor chat and capture leads.

Tara: Happy to triage and escalate.

Priya: Great — if there are no objections I'll lock the run-of-show and rehearsal times by EOD. Thanks team! :white_check_mark:

Sasha: Looks good to me. :thumbsup:

Kevin: SGTM.

Miguel: All set.

Tara: :+1:
